caption: The drawing features a jug or gravy boat positioned centrally, with a high curved lip and a handle forming an oval-shaped loop. The main body of the jug is a soft yellow or beige with purple or lavender patterns and detailing. The patterns include geometric bands and a decorative floral motif, as well as a scene featuring a pagoda and palm trees on one side. Below the jug, on the left, is a separate detailed drawing of a curved section of the jug’s rim, showing the floral pattern in purple. To the right of this, there is a vertical diagram depicting the design along the jug's handle, also in a purple or lilac shade. The background is a plain, light beige color, and there is a small inscription in the lower right reading “JULIA BRUSH.”
title: Cream Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
